svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Fleet line stack 3D: all prod-eu-1 nodes in one chart
svg.desc: 3D fleet line stack for cluster prod-eu-1 during INC-2041: about 120 node CPU lines, X = time 11:50–12:40, Y = CPU %, Z = one lane per node ordered by care score. Calm lanes are desaturated and fade into depth fog; eight lanes hosting psp-api pods lift sharply after the 12:22 onset in Degraded and Failing colour with a glow. A translucent time-cursor plane at 12:31 cuts through all lanes with correct occlusion. The hovered lane eu1-n047 has a billboard label and drives a docked linked 2D chart with value readout and −7d baseline ghost. HUD: lane-order and colour-by dropdowns, camera presets, orbit gizmo, data badge, coverage meter, per-axis zoom hint, and a Top-preset lane × time heatmap inset.

g.text: Highest care in front; 112 calm lanes
recede and fade into depth fog.
12:31 slice; lanes behind it are tinted,
lanes in front occlude it (true depth).
Hover lights one lane, docks its 2D
Billboard faces the camera; the docked
chart below shows the same series
Same lanes × time from above; T flips
to the flat chart, selection kept.
